beats.care: Check which terminal serves your town before you leave. Report private omnibuses that overcharge — RTO teams can fine them.
beats.what: Minister Vijay Tamilan Parthiban said 6,199 special buses will run from Chennai on Oct 15–18, on top of 2,191 regular buses.
beats.why: Ayudha Pooja on Oct 19 and Deepavali on Nov 8 send lakhs of people home. Splitting buses across stands eases crowding.

cards.body: Kilambakkam: Trichy, Madurai, Tirunelveli, Coimbatore and more. Madhavaram: Andhra Pradesh. Koyambedu: ECR, Kanchipuram, Vellore, Bengaluru. Maraimalai Nagar: Kumbakonam, Thanjavur.
That's regular plus special buses over three days, the minister said.
cards.caption: Buses planned for Deepavali travel days

cards.body: Free MTC shuttles will run between Kilambakkam and Maraimalai Nagar, so a wrong stand isn't a disaster.

cards.q: How are you getting home this festival?

opts: A temporary stand at Maraimalai Nagar
cards.q: Where do Kumbakonam and Thanjavur buses leave from?
cards.why: The state set up a temporary stand at Maraimalai Nagar for these routes.

hook: Going home for Ayudha Pooja? *Your bus may leave* from a new stand.

learn.t: Buses to Kumbakonam, Thanjavur and Nagapattinam will leave from a temporary stand at Maraimalai Nagar, not Kilambakkam.
